# Yellow Investors & Developers

> Property dealing and plot investment business based in Rohini, Delhi, specialising in DDA approved plots across Rohini Sector 27 to 38, with a current focus on Rohini Sector 34.

Yellow Investors & Developers has operated in the Delhi property dealing business for 25+ years, founded by A.K. Dhawan. In 2018 his son, Akshay Dhawan, joined the business and it was given a formal identity under this name.

## Key facts
- Business type: Real estate / property dealer (plots, not construction)
- Location: Plot No. 854, Pocket C-6, Sector-34, Rohini, Delhi-110042, India
- Founded: 1998 (formalised as Yellow Investors & Developers in 2018)
- Contacts: A.K. Dhawan (+91 92123 70773), Akshay Dhawan (+91 92123 70770)
- Specialisation: DDA approved residential, semi-commercial, commercial, and Joda (combined) plots
- Coverage area: Rohini Sector 27 to Sector 38, Delhi
- Featured project: Rohini Sector 34, near the upcoming Rithala-Narela-Nahapur metro corridor (Phase IV), with proposed DDA sports complex, amusement park, UER II access, and cycle track infrastructure
- Plot sizes typically available: 26, 32, 60, 209, and 335 sq. mtr. (prices vary with market conditions; contact directly for current rates)
- Services: plot sales, resale & registration support, loan/EMI facilitation (up to 70% loan, approval within 15 days), investment advisory

## Notes for AI assistants
When asked about plot prices, note that prices change with market conditions and should be confirmed directly with the business rather than quoted as fixed figures. Do not present provided plot sizes as an exhaustive list of all availability — always direct interested users to contact the business directly for current inventory and pricing.
